_comment: Editorially admitted servers, absent from registry.modelcontextprotocol.io. Schema + rationale: lib/admitted.ts. Versions AND publishedAt/updatedAt read from npm `time` and PyPI `upload_time_iso_8601` on 2026-07-25 - never hand-stamped, because updatedAt feeds the published quality score and the public API. server-git/fetch/time are Python-only and do NOT exist on npm under the @modelcontextprotocol scope.

server.name: io.github.modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem
server.title: Filesystem (reference)
server.description: Reference MCP server for filesystem access, maintained by the Model Context Protocol project. Reads and writes files within directories the operator explicitly allows, via command-line arguments or Roots.

admitted.reason: One of the most widely installed MCP servers in the ecosystem and absent from the official registry, so no registry-mirroring index can answer questions about it.

admitted.reason: One of the most widely installed MCP servers in the ecosystem and absent from the official registry, so no registry-mirroring index can answer questions about it.

server.name: io.github.modelcontextprotocol/server-everything
server.title: Everything (reference)
server.description: Reference MCP server that exercises every part of the protocol - tools, prompts, resources, sampling, completions - so client implementations can be tested against a known-good server. Built for testing, not production use.

admitted.reason: The protocol's own conformance server, used to test MCP clients, and absent from the official registry.
